options.text: How goes your fight with the trolls?

steps.player: How goes your fight with the trolls?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: I'm afraid I have bad news. We made our attack as planned, but we met unexpected resistance.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request; we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
If the player's combat level is lower than 50 or have lower than the required skills:
Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it. Your combat level is also lower than the recommended level of 50.

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: The way to the stronghold is treacherous, friend. Even if you manage to climb your way up, there will be many trolls defending the stronghold.

steps.speaker: Denulth
steps.text: God speed friend! I would send some of my men with you, but none of them are brave enough to follow.

options.text: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?

getting-started-talking-to-denulth-after.speaker: Denulth
getting-started-talking-to-denulth-after.text: How are you getting on with rescuing Godric?

getting-started-talking-to-denulth-after.player: I haven't found a way to climb up yet.

getting-started-talking-to-denulth-after.speaker: Denulth
getting-started-talking-to-denulth-after.text: Hurry, friend! Who knows what they'll do with Godric?

getting-started-talking-to-dunstan.speaker: Dunstan
getting-started-talking-to-dunstan.text: Have you managed to rescue Godric yet?

getting-started-talking-to-dunstan.speaker: Dunstan
getting-started-talking-to-dunstan.text: Please hurry! Who knows what they will do to him? Is there anything I can do in the meantime?

options.text: Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
Is it OK if I use your anvil?

getting-started-talking-to-tenzig.speaker: Tenzing
getting-started-talking-to-tenzig.text: Hello again traveller. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Sure, I'll sell you some in your size for 12 gold.
If the player has 12 gp:
Tenzing has given you some Climbing boots.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Was there anything else?
If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: I don't have the money on me.

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Was there anything else?

steps.speaker: Tenzing
steps.text: Was there anything else?

options.text: How did you find out about the secret way?

getting-started-climbing-the-rocks-north.text: If the player does not have level 15 Agility before climbing the rocks:

steps.text: You need an Agility level of at least 15 to attempt this.

getting-started-climbing-the-rocks-north.text: If the player has level 15 agility but does not have the climbing boots equipped:

steps.text: You'll need some climbing boots to go that way.

getting-started-climbing-the-rocks-north.text: If the player succeeds in climbing up the rocks:

steps.text: You climb onto the rock...
...and you step down the other side.

getting-started-climbing-the-rocks-north.text: If the player slips whilst climbing up the rocks:

steps.text: You climb onto the rock...
...but you slip back down.

getting-started-entering-dad-s-arena.speaker: Dad
getting-started-entering-dad-s-arena.text: No human pass through arena without defeating Dad!

getting-started-entering-dad-s-arena.speaker: Dad
getting-started-entering-dad-s-arena.text: What tiny human do in troll arena? Dad challenge human to fight!

steps.speaker: Dad
steps.text: Troll named after first thing try to eat!

steps.speaker: Dad
steps.text: Tiny human brave. Dad squish!
Dad swings his giant log towards the player, knocking them back.

steps.speaker: Dad
steps.text: Coward. Dad wait for braver fighter.

getting-started-after-dad-has-been-defea.speaker: Dad
getting-started-after-dad-has-been-defea.text: Stop! You win. Not hurt Dad.

steps.text: If the player attempts to attack Dad again:
You don't need to fight him again.
If the player attempts to talk to dad:
He doesn't seem interested in talking right now.

options.text: I'm not done yet! Prepare to die!

steps.player: I'm not done yet! Prepare to die!

steps.text: The player delivers a fatal blow to Dad, killing him.

entering-the-prison-talking-to-denulth-a.player: I've found my way into the prison.

entering-the-prison-talking-to-denulth-a.speaker: Denulth
entering-the-prison-talking-to-denulth-a.text: Hurry, friend. Find a way to free Godric!

entering-the-prison-retrieving-the-keys-.text: If the player chooses to pickpocket Twig:

steps.text: You attempt to pick the guard's pocket.
If the player succeeds in pickpocketing Twig:
You pick the guard's pocket and find a key.
If the player fails to pickpocket Twig:

steps.speaker: Twig
steps.text: What do you think you're doing?

entering-the-prison-retrieving-the-keys-.text: If the player pickpockets Twig again:

steps.text: You pick the guard's pocket but find nothing.

entering-the-prison-retrieving-the-keys-.text: If the player chooses to pickpocket Berry:

steps.text: You attempt to pick the guard's pocket.
If the player succeeds in pickpocketing Berry:
You pick the guard's pocket and find a key.
If the player fails to pickpocket Berry:

steps.speaker: Berry
steps.text: What do you think you're doing?

entering-the-prison-retrieving-the-keys-.text: If the player pickpockets Berry again:

steps.text: You pick the guard's pocket but find nothing.

entering-the-prison-freeing-eadgar-and-g.text: If the player attempts to open the door without a key:

steps.text: You need a key to unlock this door.

entering-the-prison-freeing-eadgar-and-g.text: If the player uses Cell key 1 or 2 on either of the doors:

steps.text: This key doesn't open this door.

entering-the-prison-freeing-eadgar-and-g.text: If the player opens Eadgar's cell with Cell key 2 in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Thanks! I'm off back home!

entering-the-prison-freeing-eadgar-and-g.text: If the player opens Godric's cell with Cell key 1 in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Godric
steps.text: Thank you, my friend.

after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.speaker: Denulth
after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.text: Oh, what great news! You should hurry to tell Dunstan, he will be overjoyed!

after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.speaker: Dunstan
after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.text: He is safe and sound, thanks to you my friend!

after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.speaker: Dunstan
after-freeing-the-prisoners-talking-to-d.text: I have very little to offer you in way of thanks, but perhaps you will accept this family heirloom. It was found by my great-great-grandfather, but we still don't have any idea what it does.
